name: rtc-studio
description: Plataforma unificada da Reforma Tributaria (LC 214/2025) sobre os motores oficiais da Receita Federal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @rtc-studio/api" "npm run dev -w @rtc-studio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rtc-studio/shared && npm run build -w @rtc-studio/api && npm run build -w @rtc-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rtc-studio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rtc-studio/api && npm run typecheck -w @rtc-studio/web
